newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy SPH foreign on dips.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Buy SPH foreign on dips.

text.p: Broking house Fraser Securities on Tuesday recommended investors buy the foreign shares of Singapore media group Singapore Press Holdings (SPH) on weakness.

It said SPH's results for the full year ended August 31, 1996 were below its expectations and it had revised downwards SPH's profit forecast for fiscal 1997 by about 10 percent to Singapore $340.60 million.
SPH announced last Friday its fiscal 1996 net profit slipped 1.1 percent to S$307.63 million after earnings were hit by higher newsprint prices and slower advertising revenue growth.

Fraser said lower newsprint prices and high value colour printing by early 1997 might alleviate the slowdown in revenue growth. It estimated newsprint prices had fallen to US$650-700 per tonne currently from US$800-850 per tonne last year.
"Valuation for SPH is about 24 times for the foreign and 13 times for local shares for FY97," said Fraser.
At 0345 GMT, SPH foreign was up S$0.10 to S$23.60.
